description_en: Queries the current sessions of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB (MongoDB) instance
description_zh: 调用GetMongoDBCurrentOp接口，获取MongoDB实例当前会话
kebab_example: aliyun das get-mongo-db-current-op --instance-id dds-uf6079bda5700000 --node-id 23302531 --role None --filter-doc active_:_true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMongoDBCurrentOp

parameters.description_en:
The node ID.
